Bioinformatics Resource Center - Rockefeller University" author: - "[http://rockefelleruniversity.github.io/responsible_use_of_AI_for_noncoders/](http://rockefelleruniversity.github.io/responsible_use_of_AI_for_noncoders/)" - "[brc@rockefeller.edu](mailto:brc@rockefeller.edu)" --- ::: {.content-hidden when-format="revealjs"} # Responsible Use of AI for Non-Coders: AI Strategy at Rockefeller ::: ## Overview - [Claude at Rockefeller](#claude-at-rockefeller) - [RU AI Sandbox](#ru-ai-sandbox) - [Policy and protected data](#policy-and-protected-data) - [Agents and further support](#agents-and-further-support) # Claude at Rockefeller {#claude-at-rockefeller background-color="#23373B" .center .middle} ## Claude for EDU Rockefeller has licensed Claude under the [**"Claude for EDU"** program](https://www.anthropic.com/news/introducing-claude-for-education). - **Data:** Sharing data with Anthropic is prevented according to our agreement - **Limits:** Usage limits/tokens should be more favorable than the standard Claude Pro/Max plans - **Life sciences:** Rockefeller has applied to the [**"Life Sciences Verification Program"**](https://www.anthropic.com/news/life-sciences-verification-program). If accepted, Rockefeller Claude users should experience reduced blocking for biological research questions. ## Integrating Claude Rockefeller is working to bring its own resources into Claude: - **Journal content:** Rockefeller intends to make journal content available to Claude when feasible - **RU-developed methods:** These will also be made available via RU Claude - **Connectors:** Used to link to RU's standard productivity tools - **Community contributions:** Feedback welcome # RU AI Sandbox {#ru-ai-sandbox background-color="#23373B" .center .middle} ## RU AI Sandbox RU has developed a private interface to select LLMs called the [**"RU AI Sandbox"**](https://it.rockefeller.edu/ruai)[VPN Required]. - Privacy is not just enforced via an agreement as the LLMs are **technically isolated**. - A chatbot/agent is available on this platform called the **"Forms and Policies Agent"**. - The goal is to integrate all or most of RU's content into this platform, as it can be challenging to navigate RU's content. # Policy and protected data {#policy-and-protected-data background-color="#23373B" .center .middle} ## AI Policy The governing policy on AI use at Rockefeller is the [**"Responsible Use of AI Policy"**](https://formspolicies.rockefeller.edu/getfile.php?type=Policy&file=IT_Responsible_AI_Use_Policy_Final_docx)[VPN required]. This includes the **"approved AI list"** # Agents and further support {#agents-and-further-support background-color="#23373B" .center .middle} ## Agentic identities Separate "identities" for your agents are available **upon request**. Especially recommended if your agent is expected to have broad autonomy or presents any sort of elevated risk
